svg.title: Agulhas Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 2000 km. Regional southward Agulhas reference route from 27 degrees S to a 40 degrees S retroflection gate near 19 degrees E. Includes an editorial approach to the turning region; stops before the eastward Agulhas Return Current. Excludes upstream Mozambique/East Madagascar branches, leakage and ring trajectories. This is a regional extent convention, not the narrower coastal-jet definition or whole Agulhas system. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate regional extent to retroflection — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Russo et al. (2022); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
